definition_english: Characterizing metaphysical doctrines, spiritual traditions, or canonical school curricula regarded as timeless, unchanging, and universally valid across historical eras (also serving as the root of the curriculum theory noun perennialism).
definition_hindi: ऐतिहासिक युगों से परे कालातीत, अपरिवर्तनीय और सार्वभौमिक रूप से मान्य माने जाने वाले तत्वमीमांसीय सिद्धांतों, आध्यात्मिक परंपराओं अथवा प्रामाणिक शैक्षिक पाठ्यचर्याओं का विशेषण (तथा पाठ्यचर्या सिद्धांत की संज्ञा 'नित्यवाद' का मूल आधार)।

hindi_equivalents_etymology.शाश्वत: Sanskrit tatsama adjective शाश्वत (śāśvata, 'eternal, perpetual, timeless'), attested in Shabdkosh and Hindi Wikipedia
hindi_equivalents_etymology.सनातन: Sanskrit tatsama adjective सनातन (sanātana, 'eternal, primeval, immemorial'), attested in Drishti IAS
hindi_equivalents_etymology.नित्य: Sanskrit tatsama adjective नित्य (nitya, 'constant, eternal, perpetual'), attested in Shabdkosh
hindi_equivalents_etymology.सार्वकालिक: Sanskrit tatsama compound सार्व + काल + इक (sārvakālika, 'belonging to all times'), attested in Shabdkosh
hindi_equivalents_etymology.नित्यवाद: Sanskrit tatsama compound नित्य + वाद (nitya + vāda, 'doctrine of the eternal/unchanging'), attested in Testbook

equivalence_mapping.usage_status: Attested on Hindi Wikipedia (शाश्वत दर्शन for Perennial Philosophy), Consciousness Atlas, Prepsnap (शाश्वत क्लासिक ग्रंथ), and Shabdkosh; offers a neutral, non-sectarian philosophical translation
Attested on Drishti IAS (सनातन दर्शन for Perennial Philosophy), though overlaps with Sanātana Dharma and can carry sectarian overtones
Attested in Shabdkosh and forms the base of the curriculum-theory term नित्यवाद (perennialism)
Attested in Shabdkosh (under perennials); emphasizes universal validity across all eras
Attested on Testbook in curriculum-theory matching questions alongside मौलिकवाद (essentialism) and प्रगतिवाद (progressivism)

syntactic_patterns: attributive adjective before philosophical, religious, or educational nouns (perennial philosophy, perennial values)
base of derived abstract noun perennialism

hindi.noun_type: Not applicable (derived noun नित्यवाद is पुल्लिंग भाववाचक संज्ञा)
hindi.gender: Invariable (अविकारी) as adjective; derived noun नित्यवाद is masculine (पुल्लिंग)
hindi.number: Invariable (अविकारी) as adjective; consonant-ending singular नित्यवाद is invariant between direct and oblique singular
hindi.case: Invariable across direct and oblique cases
hindi.adjective_agreement: Invariable (अविकारी); does not inflect across masculine (दर्शन, मूल्य, ग्रंथ) or feminine (परंपरा) head nouns

morphology.suffix: None (derived noun नित्यवाद adds -वाद [-vāda, '-ism'] to नित्य)
morphology.compound_structure: तत्सम विशेषण (शाश्वत); तत्सम भाववाचक संज्ञा (नित्य + वाद = नित्यवाद)

syntactic_patterns: attributive pre-nominal modifier before philosophical or educational nouns (शाश्वत दर्शन, शाश्वत क्लासिक ग्रंथ, सनातन दर्शन)

pronunciation.hindi_transliteration: śāśvata (variants: sanātana, nitya, sārvakālika; derived noun: nityavāda)

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: Philosophy, comparative religion, humanities, and education theory
cultural_nuances: In comparative religion and philosophy, शाश्वत दर्शन provides a neutral translation of Huxley's and Schuon's Perennial Philosophy, whereas सनातन दर्शन can evoke specific denominational associations with Sanātana Dharma.
usage_restrictions: Prefer शाश्वत दर्शन over सनातन दर्शन in secular comparative philosophy to avoid conflating comparative perennialism with Hindu religious identity.
Use नित्यवाद specifically for the educational philosophy term perennialism.
Never apply botanical (बहुवर्षी), hydrological (सदानीरा), or horticultural (बारहमासी) equivalents to philosophical doctrines.

linguistic_analysis.morphosyntax: English perennial acts as an attributive adjective (perennial philosophy, perennial values) and serves as the morphological base for perennialism. Hindi शाश्वत, सनातन, नित्य, and सार्वकालिक are invariable tatsama adjectives (अविकारी विशेषण), while perennialism maps onto the masculine -वाद abstract noun नित्यवाद.
linguistic_analysis.register_distinction: All equivalents in S5 belong to high Sanskritized academic Hindi (तत्सम), maintaining formal philosophical register.

conceptual_analysis.core_distinction: Designates timeless metaphysical truth, universal spiritual wisdom, or enduring canonical curricula valid across all historical periods.
conceptual_analysis.domain_boundary: Restricted strictly to philosophy, comparative religion, and educational theory (S5); distinct from plant life cycles (S1), hydrology (S2), general socioeconomic persistence (S3), and public administration (S4).

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both denote timeless, eternal validity across all epochs and are used to translate Perennial Philosophy (शाश्वत दर्शन / सनातन दर्शन).
pairwise_comparison.difference: शाश्वत is philosophically neutral and standard across comparative humanities (Hindi Wikipedia, Consciousness Atlas), whereas सनातन overlaps with Sanātana Dharma and carries Hindu denominational associations.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Moderate; prefer शाश्वत in secular academic and comparative-philosophy contexts.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both express unchanging philosophical permanence across time.
pairwise_comparison.difference: शाश्वत functions as the primary attributive adjective in general philosophical prose (शाश्वत दर्शन, शाश्वत क्लासिक ग्रंथ), whereas नित्य forms the established technical noun नित्यवाद for educational Perennialism.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Moderate as adjectives; use नित्यवाद exclusively for the noun perennialism.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both express validity across all historical periods.
pairwise_comparison.difference: शाश्वत emphasizes metaphysical eternity ('timeless/eternal'), whereas सार्वकालिक emphasizes applicability across all eras ('belonging to all times').
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: High in humanities and curriculum prose.

proposed_terminology.justification: शाश्वत (for philosophical and curricular permanence) and नित्यवाद (for perennialism) are already attested and clear; no new coinage is needed.

academic_acceptance: Moderate (attested across Hindi Wikipedia, Consciousness Atlas, Drishti IAS, Testbook, and Prepsnap, though peer-reviewed Hindi philosophical literature shows variation between शाश्वत दर्शन and सनातन दर्शन)
